items.title: Jack Kelly Interview, 1963-11-17
items.q: And, uh, the old man was sick that night, so he was with us with a white fellow. So he had, uh, an engagement to go down to Blackburn Parish... At the time, René was a great man during that period of time.

ctx.x: What number does she live at? We could find it. Yeah, we could find it. Yeah, we could find it, yeah. Uh-huh. Well, what, uh, let me ask you, what was the first thing you could remember about your father, you know what I mean?

Well, when, uh, one night, what made me realize how great he was, he was sick, we were living in the back of the day. Yeah. Liberty and Saline was an upstairs room. And so, at the time, René was a great man during that period of time. Mm-hmm. And, uh, the old man was sick that night, so he was with us with a white fellow. So he had, uh, an engagement to go down to Blackburn Parish, which is about 25 miles, you know, right?
